verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Ongoing stress raises your risk for metabolic syndrome.

verification_candidates.evidence_quote: All of which increase your chance of developing heart disease and diabetes.

verification_candidates.rationale: A mechanistic claim about cortisol and hippocampal volume that is checkable against neuroscience research.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Unmanaged stress can increase your risk of dementia later in life.

verification_candidates.rationale: A causal claim linking stress to dementia risk that can be checked against the evidence.

verification_candidates.rationale: A broad causal claim about unmanaged stress and mortality that can be checked against research.
